purpose: Every repair the capacity lab had to make to application ORDER during the canonical bootstrap, with the evidence for it. No file in docs/ was edited; no schema was invented — each repair moves real DDL from a docs file, or removes an object so a real ALTER can run and then puts the object back from its own file.

repairs.statementThatFailed: ALTER TABLE products ALTER COLUMN quantity TYPE numeric(18, 4); (line 128, inside a guarded DO block)
repairs.cause: products_stock_webhook_trg (AFTER UPDATE OF quantity, min_stock_level ON public.products, WHEN old/new quantity differ) was created by developer-platform-02-migration.sql lines 214-219. In the runner's alphabetical extras order 'developer-platform-*' (d) runs before 'phase-*' (p); on the live database the chronology was the opposite — phase-c-01 ran when products.quantity was still integer and no such trigger existed yet.
